entries.0035037c5fc769ba: A business supplying [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] used in automobiles.
entries.0a616af750906fba: A business supplying [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] used in automobiles. It mainly supplies microcontrollers, SoCs, analog semiconductors and power semiconductors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥639,690 million, a decrease of ¥63.1 billion (9.0%) from the previous year, due to a softening market.
entries.0adc96842f923f83: A category not included in the reportable segments, covering contract development and contract manufacturing of semiconductors carried out by Renesas' design subsidiaries and production subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,032 million.
entries.0f96098aed49819e: A category not included in the reportable segments, covering contract development and contract manufacturing of semiconductors carried out by Renesas' design subsidiaries and production subsidiaries.
entries.204a6a7844b91cc9: A business supplying semiconductors to the three fields the company positions as supporting a “smart society”: “industry,” “infrastructure” and “IoT.” It mainly supplies microcontrollers (microcomputers), SoCs, analog semiconductors and power semiconductors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥671,760 million, an increase of ¥35 billion (5.5%) from the previous year, due to higher demand in the infrastructure business.
entries.2372a3b7c0eef3dc: A semiconductor-specialized manufacturer that handles semiconductors such as microcontrollers and SoCs, which control automobiles and industrial equipment, from design through manufacturing and sales.
entries.8e903fe609cce618: It supplies semiconductors for in-vehicle information equipment, such as sensing systems that detect the environment inside and outside the vehicle, and IVI (In-Vehicle Infotainment) and instrument panels, which convey various information to drivers and others.
entries.bb8bb46a97370fa4: A business supplying semiconductors to the three fields the company positions as supporting a “smart society”: “industry,” “infrastructure” and “IoT.”
entries.eed8b0394dbf6c9d: It supplies semiconductors that control automobile engines, vehicle bodies and other components.
